# lodash.memoize v4.1.2

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.memoize` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.memoize
```

In Node.js:
```js
var memoize = require('lodash.memoize');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#memoize) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.1.2-npm-packages/lodash.memoize) for more details.
